prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website homepage direction comp
Primary request: redesign the Sabino Software homepage as a FIELD DOSSIER, a curated technical due-diligence dossier that makes a difficult-systems consultancy immediately legible and lets evidence unfold progressively.
Surface structure, in order: (1) a compact fixed header with the Sabino Software mark at left; short navigation and one clear lime conversation action at right; (2) a 1440-pixel desktop first viewport with an asymmetric 7/5 composition: on the left, a decisive offer, one short proof-bearing paragraph, and two actions; on the right, a live operating brief that looks like a calm technical dossier with status, engagement modes, and a tiny terminal/telemetry pane, all integrated over a systems-topology field; (3) enough of the next fold to show a curated stack of three production dossiers—Transfeera, Nubank, and Conta Azul—with only one dossier visibly open and the other two as compact tabs; (4) a contextual conversation strip immediately after proof. This must read as a practical, shippable responsive website, not a poster, moodboard, scene illustration, dashboard, or generic card grid.
Dominant move: the layered dossier stack and its one-open-file progressive disclosure. Keep every other region visually quieter.
Real product: Sabino Software, an engineer-led consultancy founded by Felipe Sabino. It combines technical consulting with direct implementation across data platforms, backend and distributed systems, applied AI and agents, cloud/platform infrastructure, and hardware-integrated products. Felipe Sabino remains accountable from framing through production and transfer.
Literal primary text, render verbatim where used: "Sabino Software"; "we build systems that have to work."; "bring the system"; "see selected work"; "production dossiers"; "Transfeera"; "Nubank"; "Conta Azul"; "start a conversation". Do not invent other commercial claims, client endorsements, metrics, pricing, testimonials, or customer logos.
Visual world from Image 1: carry over its near-black #080b0a ground, charcoal #111614 panels, off-white #f3f7f3 type, acid-lime #d8ff4f action color, cyan #5de4e7 telemetry, compressed bold grotesk display type, small monospaced technical labels, systems topology mesh, i3-style terminal panes, precise hairline rules, and glow used only as system signal. Do not copy Image 1's exact hero layout, line wrapping, page content, or terminal placement. This is a new structure inside the same identity.
Typography and UX constraints: editorial copy may be lowercase, but preserve official casing for Sabino Software, Felipe Sabino, AI, Transfeera, Nubank, and Conta Azul. Large readable type, calm body width, 44-pixel minimum controls, strong contrast, unmistakable reading order, ample breathing room, no tiny decorative metadata, no inaccessible low-contrast text.
Composition/framing: polished 16:10 desktop web comp, straight-on browserless canvas, show the full first viewport plus a meaningful glimpse of the second fold so the structure is undeniable.
Constraints: no fake browser chrome, no Mac-style window dots, no stock photography, no invented logos, no watermark, no overgrown bento grid, no full evidence archive, no generic SaaS dashboard. Keep the topology/terminal identity purposeful and restrained.
